speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. I understand you are experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise during your pregnancy; can you tell me exactly how many weeks pregnant you are and when these symptoms started?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you. The history of ice cream consumption followed by sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise is very concerning for Listeriosis. How high is your fever, and have you noticed any muscle aches or stiffness in your neck?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise.
